panels.description: At the GODARAZ entrance, Guddu lays a hand-woven bazaar dhurrie across the threshold. A stray dog immediately pees on it; Moti’s five-dog pack sleeps in exact shade circles nearby. Keep upper-left wall clear.
Inspector Chaudhary sits perfectly still behind one queue bench and a deliberately dry stamp pad while Guddu faces him. Leave the top third open.
Guddu holds up an unsmiling photograph of himself beside the warehouse. Keep the photograph visible and leave space for dialogue.
The Mandarin-labelled pin-setter jams above lane 3; one pin hangs crookedly. Pinty stands beside it with tools ready. Keep machine space open for lettering.

items.speaker: CHAUDHARY
items.text: Applicant and premises must both be smiling.

items.speaker: CHAUDHARY
items.text: Seniority is not delay. It is sequence.

items.speaker: PINTY
items.text: The machine is not haunted. It is emotionally overloading.
